videos.title: Eternal Truths Matter
videos.description: The question, “Who really was Jesus” has intrigued men and women down through the centuries. He either was the eternal divine Son of God or he was the world’s greatest imposter. Discover the overwhelming evidence from scripture, history, and archeology that Jesus was all He claimed to be.

videos.title: Daniel All Access
videos.description: “ENIGMA” is the name of this presentation, based on the 5th chapter in the book of Daniel. These are the closing scenes of the Neo-Babylon empire. Belshazzar was the king, and hours away from the end of his life, an enigma is presented to him in the form of mysterious writing on the wall. Once again Daniel is called to decipher the time-sensitive code message from the Lord.

videos.title: 3ABN Sabbath School Panel
videos.description: How can we tell whether someone who claims the gift of prophecy is truly speaking for God? This lesson explores the biblical tests of a genuine prophet, beginning with the counsel of 1 John 4:1 to “test the spirits.” Like a diamond examined for authenticity, prophetic claims must be carefully tested by Scripture. Discover the biblical principles that reveal whether a prophet’s message, character, predictions, and influence align with God’s Word. Learn why discernment is essential and how believers can recognize true prophetic ministry while avoiding deception with greater confidence.

videos.title: 3ABN Today Bible Q&A
videos.description: This 3ABN Today Bible Q&A tackles some of Scripture’s toughest questions: Why does Judges 11 mention a human sacrifice? Should new members be rebaptized? Will families be reunited in Heaven? Who is the woman in Revelation 12? We’ll also explore baptism, prophecy, Lot’ s choices, visions, and more—finding clear, Bible-based answers for life and faith.

They discuss why lasting family transformation begins with parents who lead by example, how to move beyond simply managing behavior to shepherding the hearts of their children, and practical steps every family can take to cultivate peace, joy, connection, and a lasting spiritual legacy.
